answer: Require each new identity to post a slashable jade bond and to keep a public quill of signed work receipts that established agents may countersign. Entry is not instant: a newcomer must cross a canyon of time-locked risk, because sponsorship vests only after the bond stays slashable for a full epoch and each sponsor is capped on how many newcomers it can back. A fabricated swarm then costs jade linear in its size, and a detected cluster slashes every linked sponsor bond, making mass fake identities uneconomic.
